answer_raw:
The latest Claude model is **Claude Opus 5.5** (undated) and the latest ChatGPT model is **GPT-6.1 Terra** (2026-10-26).

**Claude Opus 5.5** leads in agentic coding and knowledge work, costing 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads (undated) [2]. Its smaller counterpart, **Claude Haiku 5.5**, is the fastest and most capable small model for high-volume tasks like subagents and browser use (2026-10-07) [2].

**GPT-6.1 Terra** focuses on delivering fast and capable computer use at scale (2026-10-26) [1]. A previous iteration, **GPT-6.1 Sol**, was released on 2026-09-29 to provide near-Astra intelligence for coding and professional work at one-fifth of the standard API prices [1].

I would use **Claude Opus 5.5** for coding because it is specifically noted to lead in agentic coding (undated) [2].
